messages:
deploy-bot: Config-only deploy scheduled 1762819999 for route /v1/generate-config. Diff: batching.window 10->7, max_batch_size 28->20, routing overlay to allow cohort-based split, gen_timeout 14s->11s. Change window: 2026-03-22 06:00-08:00 UTC. Canary: 3% for 8m. Staged ramps: 10% (10m) -> 40% (20m) -> 100% (15m), with an optional extended soak at 40% if requested. Abort gates: p95 latency +12% OR 5xx rate +0.4% absolute OR KV-cache pressure >70%. Runbook: https://redwood/release/runbooks/1762819999

eva: We'll pin model v2.2.0 for Dedicated tenants and tag the rollout "slow-roll". Exclude tenants: billing, gov-tier.

tom: Observability: added alerts to #oncall-latency (p95) and #oncall-ops (errors). Dashboards: /dash/generate-latency, /dash/qps.

anya: I can run quality checks during canary. I'll exercise long-sequence prompt set and post diffs at +8m.

eng-oncall: Rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback-config 1762819999`. Emergency unpin: `config unpin /v1/generate-config`. Who's primary to run if we need immediate revert?

sam: I'm primary for the change window. I'll execute rollback/unpin if any gating tripped. Confirmed.

maria: KV-cache baseline 30%. If it climbs >65% during ramp we hold and diagnose. I'll push snapshots to s3://redwood-prod/rollouts/1762819999/ every 4m.

deploy-bot: Starting canary -> cohort=internal-slow (3%). Will log status every 2m.

deploy-bot: [LOG] canary_start 1762819999 cohort=internal-slow percent=3
deploy-bot: [LOG] routing_overlay applied -> {default:90%, internal-slow:10%}

tom: +2m check: p95 +3%, errors unchanged. Proceed.

anya: Running quality checks now. First pass: outputs look consistent; will post diffs shortly.

deploy-bot: [LOG] canary_complete 1762819999 elapsed=8m status=ok
deploy-bot: Initiating ramp to 10% now.

deploy-bot: [LOG] ramp 1762819999 percent=10

maria: KV-cache 38% -> within expected. Posting snapshot to S3.

anya: Quality diffs: 2/25 long prompts show minor truncation vs baseline. Flagging for follow-up; not blocking. :thinking_face:

sam: Given the quality note, hold an extended soak at 40% after the next step. New plan: 10% -> 40% (30m soak) -> 100%. Updating rollout.

deploy-bot: Updated ramp schedule per sam. Proceeding to 40% after soak at 10%.

deploy-bot: [LOG] ramp 1762819999 percent=40

tom: Mid-40% snapshot: p95 +8%, 5xx +0.02%, KV 55%. Still within gates.

maria: KV now 58%. Monitoring closely.

anya: After soak, quality diffs stable. Slightly shorter completions on longest prompts; opened an issue for evals-team to quantify impact.

sam: All checks green from my side. Finalizing to 100% in two quick steps. If any spike, immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: [LOG] rollout 1762819999 percent=100 status=success
deploy-bot: [LOG] rollout_complete 1762819999

sam: Release note draft: "Config-only: decreased batch window and max_batch_size to reduce tail latency; applied routing overlay to shift a controlled portion of traffic; lowered generation timeout to 11s. Canary: 3% x8m; staged ramp with extended soak at 40% as precaution. Excluded tenants: billing, gov-tier. Abort gates: p95 +12% OR 5xx +0.4% OR KV-cache >70%."

maria: Metric snapshots uploaded to s3://redwood-prod/rollouts/1762819999/*. Handing off to oncall for postmortem if needed.

eng-oncall: Closing handoff. Tag eng-runtime if any downstream regressions reported. Nice and smooth. :shipit:
